tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a concave substrate response and a gradient-dependent sink, but the five coupled observations leave the branch structure unidentified. A targeted open-branch measurement is warranted before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth substrate–gradient response directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations confound substrate and gradient effects and do not identify the open-branch mechanism reliably.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and more directly addresses the present mechanism ambiguity.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
